title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.17883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. translated_title: 从设计层面保障多智能体系统的安全
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务、将子任务委托给各个智能体，并使用聚合规则汇总各智能体的响应，从而解决复杂任务。恶意智能体可以通过对其被分配的子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终解决方案。在本文中，我们首先提出了响应操纵攻击，它通过迭代优化恶意响应来最大化攻击效果。具体而言，我们将无目标攻击和有目标攻击形式化为优化问题，并提出一种近似求解这些问题的方法，即基于替代多智能体系统的反馈，迭代地改进恶意响应。为防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出了SecMAS，一种安全聚合规则，它利用各智能体响应之间的语义相似性，选出与足够大的其他响应子集最为一致的响应。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了响应操纵攻击以揭示多智能体系统面对恶意响应的安全隐患，并进一步提出基于响应间语义相似性的安全聚合规则SecMAS来有效防御此类攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Response Manipulation Attacks (ReMA) to expose the vulnerability of multi-agent systems to malicious responses, and introduces SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule leveraging semantic similarities among responses to defend against such attacks.
